observations: Spreading crowns and exposed-soil opening remain recognizable at hero height.
Elevated and holdout views reveal a compact stand in a vast bare field after the unsupported matte is withheld.
Leaf-spray repetition and low-fidelity shading remain conspicuous; named roles are not supported by the current eligible catalogue.
visualCritique.decision: Reject geographic rollout of this adapter. Preserve opt-in diagnostic previews and evidence; develop source-backed profiles and regional continuation before promotion.
